state_path.description: The state path directory used by Neutron for runtime files like metadata proxy sockets.

metadata_proxy_user.description: User (uid or name) running metadata proxy after its initialization (if empty: agent effective user).

metadata_proxy_group.description: Group (gid or name) running metadata proxy after its initialization (if empty: agent effective group).

nova_metadata_host.description: IP address or DNS name of Nova metadata server.

nova_metadata_port.description: TCP Port used by Nova metadata server.

metadata_proxy_shared_secret.description: Shared secret for signing Instance-ID header to prevent spoofing.

nova_metadata_protocol.description: Protocol to access Nova metadata, http or https.

nova_metadata_insecure.description: Allow to perform insecure SSL (https) requests to Nova metadata.

nova_client_cert.description: Client certificate for Nova metadata api server.

metadata_proxy_socket_mode.description: Metadata Proxy UNIX domain socket mode (deduce, user, group, all).

metadata_workers.description: Number of separate worker processes for metadata server.

metadata_backlog.description: Number of backlog requests to configure the metadata server socket with.

debug.description: If set to true, the logging level will be set to DEBUG instead of the default INFO level.

watch_log_file.description: Uses logging handler designed to watch file system for log file rotation.

syslog_log_facility.description: Syslog facility to receive log lines.

log_color.description: Set the 'color' key according to log levels.

log_rotate_interval.description: The amount of time before the log files are rotated.

max_logfile_count.description: Maximum number of rotated log files.

max_logfile_size_mb.description: Log file maximum size in MB.

publish_errors.description: Enables or disables publication of error events.

rate_limit_interval.description: Interval, number of seconds, of log rate limiting.

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum number of logged messages per rate_limit_interval.

rate_limit_except_level.description: Log level name used by rate limiting.

fatal_deprecations.description: Enables or disables fatal status of deprecations.

rate_limit_enabled.description: Enable rate limiting on the metadata API.

ip_versions.description: Comma separated list of the metadata address IP versions (4, 6) for which rate limiting will be enabled.

base_window_duration.description: Duration (seconds) of the base window on the metadata API.

base_query_rate_limit.description: Max number of queries to accept during the base window.

burst_window_duration.description: Duration (seconds) of the burst window on the metadata API.

burst_query_rate_limit.description: Max number of queries to accept during the burst window.

ovsdb_connection.description: The connection string for the native OVSDB backend.

ovsdb_connection_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the OVSDB connection transaction.
